skill.name: Notion API
skill.description: Access a connected Notion workspace to search pages and databases, read content, create pages, update page properties, and query databases.
skill.summary: Manage shared Notion pages and databases through the official Notion API.
skill.author: BLTGV

security_audit.summary: All 124 static detections were adjudicated as false positives. The skill uses the official Notion API and a single NOTION_TOKEN for its documented purpose; no shell execution, arbitrary network destination, host reconnaissance, obfuscation, or prompt-injection content was found. Page creation, updates, database queries, and archiving remain consequential user-authorized actions.

remediation.issue: Write and archive operations can change workspace content.
remediation.suggestion: Request clear user confirmation before creating, updating, or archiving a Notion page, and identify the target page or database.

remediation.issue: API requests have no explicit endpoint validation in the shared client.
remediation.suggestion: Keep callers limited to fixed Notion API paths and validate identifiers before constructing endpoint strings.

remediation.issue: The integration token is supplied through an environment variable.
remediation.suggestion: Document secure secret storage and advise users not to paste NOTION_TOKEN values into prompts or command history.

content.value_statement: Finding and updating shared Notion content can require repetitive API work. This skill provides focused commands for searching, reading, creating, updating, and querying Notion content through an integration.
actual_capabilities: Search accessible Notion pages and databases by query or object type.
Read a page and return its title, properties, parent, status, and URL.
Create child pages or database entries with a title, properties, and optional emoji icon.
Update page titles, properties, icons, and archived status.
Retrieve database schemas and query database entries with filters, sorting, and limits.
Read page blocks, including nested blocks when requested.
limitations: Requires a valid NOTION_TOKEN for a Notion integration.
Only pages and databases shared with the integration are accessible.
Does not create integrations, manage workspace permissions, or bypass Notion access controls.
Uses the Notion API version specified by the skill and is subject to Notion API limits.

use_cases.title: Find project notes
use_cases.description: Search a shared workspace for meeting notes, project pages, or databases, then review matching content.

use_cases.title: Maintain task records
use_cases.description: Query a task database, create an entry, and update its properties after user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Review documentation
use_cases.description: Read page blocks and database schemas to understand existing technical documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Search for a page
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my connected Notion workspace for pages matching "weekly planning". Show the title and link for each result.

prompt_templates.title: Read a page
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the Notion page with ID <page-id> and summarize its title, properties, and block content.

prompt_templates.title: Query a task database
prompt_templates.prompt: Query the Notion database <database-id> for tasks with Status equal to In Progress. Sort by last edited time and return the first 20 results.

prompt_templates.title: Create a reviewed entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a new entry in Notion database <database-id> titled "Release checklist" with the provided properties. Show the planned changes and ask for confirmation before creating it.

output_examples.input: Search for pages about quarterly planning.
output: Matching pages found: Q3 Planning, Quarterly Goals, and Planning Notes.
Each result includes its page title, identifier, link, and last edited time.

output_examples.input: Query open tasks in a project database.
output: The result lists matching task entries with their titles and available properties.
The response also indicates whether more results are available.

output_examples.input: Create a new database entry after confirmation.
output: A new entry is created in the selected database with the requested title and properties.
The response includes the entry identifier, link, and creation details.

best_practices: Share only the required pages and databases with the Notion integration.
Confirm the target and intended changes before creating, updating, or archiving content.
Use narrow database filters and result limits to reduce unnecessary data access.
anti_patterns: Do not paste a Notion integration token into a prompt, source file, or command history.
Do not archive or update a page without confirming its identifier and intended effect.
Do not assume the integration can access content that has not been explicitly shared with it.

faq.question: What authentication does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires NOTION_TOKEN, an internal integration token created in your Notion workspace.

faq.question: Why cannot the skill find a page?
faq.answer: The page or database must be shared with the integration before the Notion API can access it.

faq.question: Can the skill create pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create child pages and database entries when you provide the required parent identifier and title.

faq.question: Can the skill modify existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update titles, properties, icons, and archived status for pages accessible to the integration.

faq.question: Can the skill search databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It can query databases with supported filters, sorting, and result limits.

faq.question: Does the skill manage Notion permissions?
faq.answer: No. Workspace permissions and sharing are managed in Notion, outside this skill.
